title: Ideal class monoids of cubic orders
summary: Let $R$ be an order in a number field, let $\overline{\mathrm{Cl}}(R)$ be its ideal class monoid, and let $\mathrm{Cl}(R)$ act on it by multiplication. The local-global product formula identifies the orbit set $\mathrm{Cl}(R)\backslash\overline{\mathrm{Cl}}(R)$ with a product of local orbit sets; in this sense, it is the genus set of fractional $R$-ideals. For a Gorenstein order $R$ in a cubic extension of number fields, we give a closed Euler product formula for the cardinality of this genus set.
